title: Pair Sum
content_md: Given an array of integers `nums` and an integer `target`, return the indexes of the two values that add up to `target`. Each input has exactly one answer, and you may not use the same index twice. Aim for better than a nested loop.
hints: A map from value to index lets you look up the complement as you scan.

title: Balanced Brackets
content_md: A string contains the brackets `()`, `[]`, and `{}`. Return true when every opener is closed by the matching closer, in the right order.
hints: A stack of openers is enough. The closer must match the most recent opener.

title: Reverse a Chain
content_md: Reverse a singly linked list of `ListNode` values and return the new head. Do it in place.
hints: Keep previous, current, and next. Advance current only after you have saved next.
